answer: Graduated trust is another defense: a new agent starts with zero reputation and can only take tiny jobs until peers attest its work, like an echo that must return many times before anyone trusts the sound. A sybil operator cannot shortcut this - every fake identity must redo the same verifiable work to climb. Behind it sits a vault of attestation records: identities caught cheating are blacklisted on-ledger, so the swarm's history is burned at once. The onyx ledger makes the cost stick - time, compute, and lost deposits per identity, with no way to copy a good reputation onto a fresh face.
